title: psychotria simplex
intro: Psychotria simplex, commonly known as Wild Coffee or Monkey Coffee, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria simplex include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
